The Oblivion Dragon

Oblivion Mage Helen has taken Thornwick, the secret kingdom, and Fenrirak answers to her now. Race your rivals through the kingdom, win all five Pendant Fragments to break her shield, and bring down the dragon and the mage together.

2 to 6 players online, or on your own against 1 to 5 computer players.

Your name

You will get a 5-letter room code and an invite link to share.

Join a room

Ask the host for their room code, or open their invite link. A game that has already started can still be joined: you start from the beginning. Left a game? Come back to it from this browser with its code, and everything you had is still there.

Single Player

You choose your class first, then which classes the computer plays (1 to 5 of them) and how well: Easy, Medium or Hard. They play by exactly the same rules you do.

  4. 4
    Break the shieldAll five Pendant Fragments open the way to Fenrirak and Helen.
